MassTransit.// OutboxQueryDelaySeconds: Production polls the outbox every 5s instead of the 1s default. At 1s the two sweepers ran ~172k queries a day, idle or not — the dominant source of database chatter and of the retained-per-operation memory growth. 5s is still half of MassTransit's own default, so esteira events stay prompt.

// Logging: Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Database.Command logs every executed SQL statement at Information. In production that was 2.5M records per fortnight — 99.9% of all traces — duplicating what the dependency spans already carry, SQL text included. Warning keeps the failures and drops the duplication. NB: this note lives outside the Logging section on purpose — every key inside Logging:LogLevel is parsed as a log level, so a '// key' comment in there throws at startup.
